data.name: Extreme Climbing
data.detailed_description: Unarmed climbing of world famous buildings: Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Tokyo Sky Tree Tower, Dubai Tower, Pyramid, Guangzhou Tower, Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower, CCTV Tower, etc.
data.about_the_game: Unarmed climbing of world famous buildings: Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Tokyo Sky Tree Tower, Dubai Tower, Pyramid, Guangzhou Tower, Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower, CCTV Tower, etc.
data.short_description: Unarmed climbing of world famous buildings: Eiffel Tower, Statue of Liberty, Tokyo Sky Tree Tower, Dubai Tower, Pyramid, Guangzhou Tower, Oriental Pearl TV Tower Tower, CCTV Tower, etc.
data.supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Portugal, Korean
data.reviews:
“This is the game I have been waiting for!!! To me there is something much more scary about climbing a man-made concrete structure than a 'natural' scenic cliff or mountain. And this 'Tree Of Life' skyscraper scared me almost to death. I would happily have paid 20-30 pounds JUST FOR THIS ONE BUILDING.”
5 – cassey_neil

“The immersion is quite good. When it comes to the later levels, it feels very high and scary when climbing ﻿”
5 – hd19830511

“There is a mysterious magic of this game.”
5 – SKeLeton

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: WINDOWS® 7, 8, 8.1, 10 (32/64-BIT)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590, AMD FX 8350 equivalent or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 7 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus PC. Room Scale 2m by 1.5m area required
  • Additional Notes: HDMI 1.4, DisplayPort 1.2 or newer
